learning.title: A new output field is additive only when every schema that carries it lists it as optional
learning.trigger: A field is added to an output in docs/technical-design/transport-schemas.json, and a projection of the same record exists.
learning.mistake: The base-ref compatibility check rejects any new member of a schema's required list. An output and its projection are separate OpenAPI schemas, so listing the field in the output's optionalFields alone still fails with `schemas.<projection>.required: field became required`. A nullable type does not make a field optional.
learning.rule: List every new field in optionalFields on the output and on each projection that carries it, run `pnpm catalog:literals` and then `pnpm contracts:generate -- --base-ref origin/main`, and expect exit 0 without a compatibility migration. Do not edit the approval file to get past a drift error.

verification.requirement: `pnpm contracts:generate -- --base-ref origin/main` exits 0 without --compatibility-migration, and removing the projection optionalFields in a scratch copy makes it exit 1.
